what: A large wordmark floating at the center of the hero (width min(640px, 80vw), top edge half a small-logo height above screen center) is bound directly to scroll (no curve) while scrolling half the screen height from the top, shrinking up into the header’s center logo slot (15px from top · slot width). Progress 0~1 is exported as --fx-dock so the header menu can open up the center. Once fully shrunk, the large wordmark hides and the small logo in the slot turns on. Scrolling back up reverses it

options.dist: Scroll distance to shrink (multiple of screen height), default .5
options.top: Top margin when fully shrunk (px), default 15
options.max: Max width of large wordmark (px), default 640
options.vw: Share of screen width for large wordmark, default .8
options.width: Small logo width (px) used when the slot width can’t be measured, default 240
options.[data-fx-part=slot]: Small logo spot at the center of the header (required) — shrinks to this width
options.--fx-dock: Progress of the export (0~1) — used for things like the center spread width of a header menu
options.at: bottom — lays a large wordmark on the screen bottom (bottom px up) and shrinks it upward until its lower edge touches the line top px from the screen top (frost: at: bottom; vw: .95; max: 99999; top: 60; dist: 1)
options.bottom: Initial bottom margin (px) when at: bottom, default 20
options.at: flow: Keep the large wordmark in the document flow and only scale it from 1 → slot width/wordmark width around its top-left origin. While scrolling down from the top by wordmark top edge − slot top edge (no curve), the wordmark that has scrolled up lands exactly on the header slot. When fully shrunk, the wordmark gets opacity 0, the slot gets opacity 1 and visible, and the element gets is-docked (used to paint the header background) (paradox-series)

note: When a menu or drawer opens, the original sets progress to 1 and hides the big wordmark — the consuming side handles that state with [data-fx-part=mark] hidden to match. The original turns on the big wordmark .5s after ready with .5s cubic-bezier(.76,.015,.41,1) · frost (at: bottom) ends at the Hero bottom edge 10px above the screen top, so it is 10px shorter than dist 1, and when the body touches the top of the screen (dist 1) the big logo and the header logo swap — the 10px difference is treated as dist 1

from.where: shared.js · center header logo (original #pageHeaderLogoLarge → .pageHeaderLogo, top 15·width 240, end +=50vh scrub)
